articles.standfirst: Jon Rahm will leave LIV Golf after deeming the terms for LIV 2.0 "unacceptable", his lawyer has told a bankruptcy court hearing.

gist: Jon Rahm is leaving LIV Golf after finding LIV 2.0 terms unacceptable.
LIV Golf filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after losing Saudi funding.
Rahm tops the list of creditors with an unsecured claim of $7.5m.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Jon Rahm is set to leave LIV Golf because he considers the terms of LIV 2.0 unacceptable. LIV Golf filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the United States in September following the withdrawal of Saudi Arabia's funding. The league has secured possible financing from BC Partners Credit for the 2027 season. Rahm and LIV representatives are in advanced discussions for a consensual separation agreement.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Rahm is owed an unsecured claim of $7.5m, making him the top creditor among the 30 largest unsecured claims. Participants are owed at least $45m and can leave, as players have no obligation to sign on to LIV 2.0.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Talks are open until 25 October, and it is hoped that a consensual separation agreement will be finalised by a court hearing on 5 November.

gist: JJ Gabriel features in Manchester United's official team photo despite efforts to leave.
Europe's top clubs are interested in the teenager as he holds a European Union passport.
His decision to seek a move was triggered by non-inclusion against Sabah FK.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: JJ Gabriel is included in Manchester United's official team photo for the season. The pictures were taken before he informed the club of his intention to leave. His exit decision was triggered by not being included in the squad to face Sabah FK.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Gabriel is a target for several top European clubs, including Real Madrid and Barcelona. Manchester United hold his registration and would consider legal action if illegal inducement emerges.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Gabriel is set to turn 16 and his next involvement in a United game will virtually certainly be as an opposition player.
